newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline steady, some buying interest seen.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline steady, some buying interest seen.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices were steady to slightly firmer on Monday morning.
Traders said there was some slightly better buying interest and bids were edging higher, but buyers and sellers still remained around $2 apart.
On the key Rotterdam barge market prompt lifting Eurograde barges talked $192/$194 fob with amply supplied regular around $8-$9 below this.

Eurograde cargoes were thinly talked $196/$198 cif NWE. Traders said there was still little sign of product moving transatlantic but said there was plenty of oil in Europe should U.S. demand start to pick up.
